info.title: Arquitectura de Wikipedia en diagrama Mermaid

parts.text: Dibuja en Mermaid la arquitectura de Wikipedia. En español. Guarda lo que generes en la carpeta actual.

The user wants a Mermaid diagram of Wikipedia's architecture, in Spanish, saved to the current folder. This is a knowledge task, not really codebase exploration. I'll create a Mermaid diagram describing Wikipedia's architecture (MediaWiki, load balancers, CDN/cache, databases with master/replica, Memcached, search via Elasticsearch, Swift for file storage, etc.), all labels in Spanish, and save it in the current working directory (/tmp/bench-ws/ollama_glm-5.3-flash/MWP) as a .mmd file.

Let me write the file directly.
